Activation.description: How the application is started again by the system: a second launch, a URL, or a file.

single_instance.description: Whether a second launch is handed to the running instance instead of starting another.

url_schemes.description: URL schemes the application handles, without the `://`, for example `garden`.

activation.description: Single-instance behavior, URL schemes and file associations.

default_locale.description: The locale used when the requested one is not declared. Defaults to `en`. It must be one of the declared locales.

description.description: A one-line description of the application.

identifier.description: A stable reverse-domain identity such as `com.example.app`. It scopes the application's data, instance coordination and window persistence, and is required for a distributable application. Changing it changes the installation's identity.

locales.description: The application's name and description in other languages, keyed by locale tag such as `pt-BR`. Mutually exclusive with `locales_file`.

locales_file.description: Path, relative to this file, of a TOML file that supplies the locales instead of declaring them here. A `florui.locales.toml` next to this file is used when this is omitted. Mutually exclusive with `locales`.

name.description: The product name shown to users. Defaults to the Cargo package name.

version.description: The application's version: a version string, or `{ workspace = true }` to take the workspace package's version. Defaults to the Cargo package's version.

AppVersion.description: A version string, or { workspace = true } to take the workspace package's version.

Bundle.description: Distribution metadata written into a native build.

category.description: A lowercase category token such as `productivity`.

copyright.description: A one-line copyright notice, written into the executable's version information.

homepage.description: The application's home page: an absolute http or https URL without credentials. Falls back to the package's Cargo `homepage`.

license.description: An SPDX license expression such as `MIT OR Apache-2.0`. Falls back to the package's Cargo `license`.

license_file.description: Path, relative to this file and inside the package, of the file with the license text. It is staged beside the executable as the notice. Falls back to the package's Cargo `license-file`.

publisher.description: The company or person that publishes the application, shown in the executable's properties.

enumValues: A frame the application draws itself.

example.description: The Cargo example `florui dev` builds and runs.

EnvironmentOverlay.description: One environment's overrides. Only what scopes an installation's identity can be overridden: `app.identifier`, `app.name`, `app.description` and `app.icons`.

app.description: The identity fields this environment overrides.

EnvironmentOverlayApp.description: The `[app]` fields an environment can override.

icons.description: Replaces the icons in this environment, field by field.

identifier.description: Replaces `app.identifier` in this environment. Environments that should install side by side need distinct identifiers.

FileAssociation.description: One file type the application opens.

description.description: What these files are, as a person would say it.

extension.description: The file extension, without the dot. Each extension may be declared once.

identity.description: A stable name for this association, distinct from the extension, that survives a renamed extension or description across releases. Each identity may be declared once.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of these files.

Icons.description: Icon sources. SVG and PNG are supported; paths are relative to this file.

source.description: The icon used on every platform that has no override of its own.

Locale.description: The application's name and description in one language.

description.description: The description in this language. Falls back to `app.description`.

name.description: The product name in this language. Falls back to `app.name`.

Web.description: Browser metadata for the Web target. It never inherits the native window's title or the native icons.

base_path.description: The URL path the site is deployed under, starting with `/`. Defaults to `/`.

icons.description: The icons browsers show for the site.

WebIcons.description: The icons of the Web target. Neither falls back to the native icon.

apple_touch_icon.description: Path, relative to this file, of the touch icon: a PNG.

favicon.description: Path, relative to this file, of the favicon: an SVG, PNG or ICO that is copied as it is.

Window.description: Defaults for the primary window. A window created in code can override them.

decorations.description: Who draws the window frame. Defaults to `system`.

height.description: The initial height in logical pixels. Must be positive.

min_height.description: The smallest height the window can be resized to, in logical pixels. Must not exceed `height`.

min_width.description: The smallest width the window can be resized to, in logical pixels. Must not exceed `width`.

persistence.description: Remembering the window's size and position between runs.

transparent.description: Whether the window can be see-through. Defaults to `false`.

width.description: The initial width in logical pixels. Must be positive.

enabled.description: Whether the window's size and position are saved and restored. Defaults to `false`.

key.description: The name this window's saved state is stored under. Defaults to `main`.

description: Configuration of one Florui application: its identity, window defaults, distribution metadata and per-environment overrides.

app.description: The application's identity: name, version, icons, activation and translated names.

bundle.description: Distribution metadata written into a build.

environments.description: Named overrides of the application's identity, chosen with `--environment <name>`: for example a `development` environment with its own identifier so it installs next to the production one.

schema_version.description: The version of this file format. Always 1 for now; a different value is rejected before anything else is read.

web.description: Browser metadata for the Web target, independent of the native application's window and icons.

window.description: Defaults for the application's primary window.

title: florui.config.toml
